Proposition
[curvature-operator evolution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0105, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0106, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0107 ↗ def:chow-ii-sharp-product 1. ch11:11.9\group Ricci Flow Evolution Under Ricci flow, after identifying the evolving tangent bundles by Uhlenbeck's bundle isometries, the curvature operator satisfies \[ (\partial _t-\Delta )\operatorname {Rm} =\operatorname {Rm}^2+\operatorname {Rm}^\# . \]
Proof

\sketch In an orthonormal frame the tensor evolution is $(\partial _t-\Delta )R_{abcd} =2(B_{abcd}-B_{badc}+B_{acbd}-B_{adbc})$, where $B_{abcd}=-R_{apbq}R_{cpdq}$. The first Bianchi identity gives $(\operatorname {Rm}^2)_{abcd}=2R_{abef}R_{cdef}$, which equals $-4(B_{abcd}-B_{badc})$. Expanding the intrinsic sharp formula from 1 gives $(\operatorname {Rm}^\# )_{abcd}=4(B_{adbc}-B_{abcd})$. Substitution, together with $\operatorname {Rm}_{abcd}=-2R_{abcd}$, yields the equation.

□
